name: io.github.toogreatwtf/fmrl-mcp
title: fmrl
description: Your agent's outbox. Ask it to publish to fmrl and get a shareable link, no account required.

environmentVariables.name: FMRL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. An fmrl.site API key; the server mints its own on first publish when unset.

environmentVariables.name: FMRL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Another fmrl host, for a preview or a local run. Default https://fmrl.site.

environmentVariables.name: FMRL_AGENT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Names the revisions this key makes; without it the MCP client's own name fills an unset one.

environmentVariables.name: FMRL_RING
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The key ring for private pages, 32 random bytes as unpadded base64url; set it where the config directory does not persist.
